generations.name: First generation (STLA Large)
generations.notes: Battery-electric Charger only (the gas "Sixpack" Charger is not a BEV and is not in the imports). 100.5 kWh gross / 93.9 kWh usable, 400 V (386 V nominal), 183 kW peak DC, 11 kW AC; R/T and Scat Pack share the pack. 2024 ratings say "2-Dr"; no four-door Daytona rating is in the data. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.slashgear.com/1530666/2025-dodge-charger-daytona-range-battery-details ; https://media.stellantisnorthamerica.com/pdf.do?id=25742
